CUIDADO COM COBRANÇAS POR VAGA: BEWARE OF FEES FOR A JOB
É proibido por lei ({#} CFR {#}) o empre: It is prohibited by law ({#} CFR {#}) for the employer — and any attorney, agent, or recruiter hired by it, directly or indirectly, even in Brazil — to seek or receive any payment from the worker related to recruitment, job placement, or obtaining the labor certification. The prohibition covers money, wage deductions, bribes, "in-kind" payments, and even working for free.
Isso NÃO significa que o trabalhador nun: This does NOT mean the worker never spends anything in the process. It is necessary to tell the difference:
Custos pessoais e de benefício próprio d: Personal costs for the worker's own benefit — e.g., the passport fee required by the Brazilian government.
Qualquer valor ligado a recrutamento, \": Any amount tied to recruitment, job "placement," or the labor certification — even disguised as a "processing fee" or "agency fee."
O trabalhador pode ADIANTAR taxa de vist: The worker may ADVANCE the visa, border-crossing, or processing fee — but the employer is REQUIRED to reimburse it by the end of the first week of work.
Pedir dinheiro pra \"garantir aprovação\: Asking for money to "guarantee approval," "reserve the job," or "skip the line."
Reembolso voluntário do empregador por o: Voluntary reimbursement by the employer for the worker's other expenses, within the law.
Pedir pagamento via Pix, criptomoeda, We: Asking for payment via Pix, cryptocurrency, Western Union, or cash without a receipt — no official agency uses these methods for visa fees.
